notes.title: We published an update, fixed minor bugs
notes.notes:
Friends, yesterday we published version 1.1.5 of the game. What is included in the patch? 

- Fixed a bug with the phone button (removed multiple clicks). At the beginning of the second episode, a mysterious stranger endlessly asked some players, "Do you want to go to the zone?" 
- Fixed a bug with loading the game after the scene with the stone in the swamp
- Fixed a bug with multiple repetition of Kris's lines 
- Removed the bug with the launch of the video via a mysterious link from the SMS at the end of the first episode 

Thank you for helping us test the game and showing us the flaws, we try to fix everything promptly. Peace to all!

notes.title: Devblog: how are the preparations for the release of episode 2 going
notes.notes:
While everyone was celebrating and then moving away from the holidays, our team did not sit idly by. We will tell you what happened to us.

The second part is much more difficult than the first, both technically and logically. We expect that the technical release of the second episode will take place in mid-March, but there may be slight shifts. It all depends on the testing stage and the presence of errors.

In the meantime, we are working tirelessly.

The script of the second episode was finally approved. The gameplay of episode 2 is about an hour and a half, many new characters have appeared in it, and the action will take place not only in our days, but also in the past.

We started the voice acting: the script was read by the roles. For some characters, the voiceover has already been recorded and is waiting for the assembled scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/7e627f1756205baf21bcbfb42154e13d0c72edb6.jpg[/img]

Models of all the characters were ready at the end of last year, and this year we made models of cars, residential buildings and public institutions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/ebfffb204e4e5d218cc41e3fa153a6cb6bfdfd21.jpg[/img]

As for realism, our designer recently completed the entrance and apartment of Nick's parents, and his attention to detail will really make you believe in the reality of what is happening. There are homemade knitted doormats and the burnt buttons in the elevator. The broom tiles on the floor and the inscriptions on the entrance walls are not forgotten – a mandatory attribute of a typical Russian house in a rough neighborhood, where Nick comes from. The location turned out to be very cool. Enjoy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324829/881f468a90825da22e4ab38a3a226a1b0041c471.jpg[/img]

The assembly of the scenes is in full swing and very soon we will be able to show the first teasers. Follow the news!

notes.title: Release schedule of new episodes
notes.notes:
We are often asked: when will the next episode be released? 

We answer: we are working on the second episode right now. Its release is scheduled for February 2024. In it, you will find a continuation of the story, an investigation, and of course, new characters. 

There will be 4 episodes in total in the novella. There is a lot of work ahead, we are serious and we are not going to slow down. We look forward to your support and feedback!

notes.title: Update from September 28
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, dear players. We are continuing to work on the game and have prepared several changes that are included in the new version:
- added emotions to the characters, now they better reflect their attitude to what is happening
- now Chris has several clothing options, she changes clothes depending on where she is going
- achievements have appeared in the game, you will have to try to get them. 

We hope this will make the game even more interesting.
